prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1401; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact collision while the patient was turning left at low speed. Presenting complaints included neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain. Over the course of eight visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided range-of-motion exercises, and home exercise instruction. The injury mechanism described is plausible for this type of crash, and the clinical course followed a typical pattern, with symptoms and visit frequency tapering as the patient improved. Examination documented reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal tenderness, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening and certain orthopedic tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the cervical spine or upper back. Billing records include two similar charges on the same date of service, which are currently under review for accuracy. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
